create or alter procedure [graph].[Hop_LoadHopHierarchies] @hopSalt varchar(25), @direction char(1), @hopNumber int as begin with h as ( select L.RowID, A.ID, A.Uid, I.Object, I.ObjectID, P.ID ParentID, I.Subject as ParentObject, I.SubjectID as ParentObjectID from Asset A inner join #links L on L.ID = A.ID and L.Direction = @direction and L.HopNumber = @hopNumber left join PredicateIntersect I on I.PredicateType in (3,4) and I.Object = A.Object and I.ObjectID = A.ObjectID left join Asset P on P.Object = I.Subject and P.ObjectID = I.SubjectID union all select h.RowID, A.ID, A.Uid, A.Object, A.ObjectID, I.ParentID, I.Subject as ParentObject, I.SubjectID as ParentObjectID from h inner join Asset A on h.ParentObject = A.Object and h.ParentObjectID = A.ObjectID outer apply ( select P.ID as ParentID, I.Subject, I.SubjectID from PredicateIntersect I inner join Asset P on P.Object = I.Subject and P.ObjectID = I.SubjectID where I.PredicateType in (3,4) and I.Object = A.Object and I.ObjectID = A.ObjectID ) I ) insert into #nodes ([Level], [Position], AssetUid, AssetID, [Key], ParentID, ParentKey, Back, Fore, Icon, AssetTypeID, AssetTypeUid, Class, DisplayValue, Reveal, ActionCount, RelationCounts, UseAsTransformation, IsLeaf, Parsed, IsFocal) select 1 as [Level] ,1 as [Position] ,A.Uid as AssetUid ,h.ID AssetID ,case when L.[Key] is not null and A.Uid = L.AssetUid then L.[Key] else utility.GetHash(@hopSalt + '|' + cast(A.ID as varchar(50)) ) end as [Key] ,h.ParentID ,iif( h.ParentID is null, null, utility.GetHash(@hopSalt + '|' + cast(h.ParentID as varchar) ) ) as [ParentKey] ,A.BackColor as Back ,A.ForeColor as Fore ,A.Icon ,A.AssetTypeID ,A.AssetTypeUid ,A.AssetTypeClass as Class ,D.DisplayValue ,0 as Reveal ,0 as ActionCount ,'[]' as RelationCounts ,0 as UseAsTransformation ,cast(0 as bit) as IsLeaf ,0 as Parsed ,L.IsFocal from #links L inner join h on h.RowID = L.RowID inner join AssetWithType A on A.ID = h.ID inner join AssetDisplayValue D on D.AssetID = A.ID where L.Direction = @direction and L.HopNumber = @hopNumber;
update #nodes set IsLeaf = 1 where AssetID not in (select ParentID from #nodes); end
changeSet.rollback: create or alter procedure [graph].[Hop_LoadHopHierarchies] @hopSalt varchar(25), @direction char(1), @hopNumber int as begin insert into #nodes ([Level], [Position], AssetUid, AssetID, [Key], ParentID, ParentKey, Back, Fore, Icon, AssetTypeID, AssetTypeUid, Class, DisplayValue, Reveal, ActionCount, RelationCounts, UseAsTransformation, IsLeaf, Parsed, IsFocal) select doc.c.value('level', 'int') as [Level] ,doc.c.value('position', 'int') as [Position] ,A.Uid as AssetUid ,doc.c.value('assetId', 'bigint') as AssetID ,case when L.[Key] is not null and A.Uid = L.AssetUid and doc.c.value('leaf', 'bit') = 1 then L.[Key] else utility.GetHash(@hopSalt + '|' + cast(A.ID as varchar(50)) + '|' + cast( doc.c.value('level', 'int') * doc.c.value('position', 'int') as varchar ) ) end as [Key] ,doc.c.value('parentAssetId', 'bigint') as ParentID ,iif( doc.c.value('parentAssetId', 'bigint') = 0, null, utility.GetHash(@hopSalt + '|' + doc.c.value('parentAssetId', 'varchar(50)') + '|' + cast( doc.c.value('parentLevel', 'int') * doc.c.value('parentPosition', 'int') as varchar ) ) ) as [ParentKey] ,A.BackColor as Back ,A.ForeColor as Fore ,A.Icon ,coalesce(A.AssetTypeID, doc.c.value('assetTypeId', 'int')) as AssetTypeID ,A.AssetTypeUid ,A.AssetTypeClass as Class ,doc.c.value('value', 'nvarchar(250)') as DisplayValue ,0 as Reveal ,0 as ActionCount ,'[]' as RelationCounts ,0 as UseAsTransformation ,case when doc.c.value('leaf', 'bit') = 1 then cast(1 as bit) else cast(0 as bit) end as IsLeaf ,0 as Parsed ,L.IsFocal from #links L inner join graph.AssetNode N on N.Uid = L.AssetUid cross apply N.ReformattedSegments.nodes('/path/segment') doc(c) inner join AssetWithType A on A.ID = doc.c.value('assetId', 'bigint') where L.Direction = @direction and L.HopNumber = @hopNumber; end
